messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

Recommendation: prioritize R&S CMX500 signaling capabilities for automotive connectivity, infotainment, and emergency-call testing; keep radar echo generation and PCB/SerDes signal-integrity work as important adjacent automotive test areas, but not primary “signaling tester” capabilities [9][12][16][26].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Automotive need it can address | Knowledge-base-confirmed option / spec | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Automotive connectivity, eCall, infotainment, and wireless device validation | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD; NR/LTE signaling; WLAN signaling; fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI, throughput, PER; IMS/audio/POLQA [9] | It is the main R&S signaling platform in the passages and directly covers cellular, WLAN, application, IMS/audio, and performance testing [9]. | [9] | Pricing and full automotive test-package configuration are not stated. |
| R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | NG eCall testing | R&S CMX-KA098 software option for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [12] | It was used to verify NG eCall for Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF, simulating a PSAP and validating EN 17240:2024 voice/data compliance [12]. | [12] | The passages do not provide a complete certification test-plan list. |
| R&S CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 signaling | Automotive infotainment/connectivity WLAN validation | Integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality; signaling-mode RF TX/RX; MLO; 2x2 MIMO; 6 GHz out-of-band discovery; coexistence; E2E [16] | Wi‑Fi 7 signaling in real-world conditions supports connected infotainment and coexistence-style validation [16][26]. | [16][26] | Automotive-specific Wi‑Fi 7 test cases are not enumerated. |
| R&S CMP180 | Production RF testing complement, not primary signaling | Production non-signaling RF testing for Wi‑Fi 7 [8] | It complements CMX500 when moving from R&D signaling to production non-signaling RF testing [8]. | [8] | Not a signaling capability in the cited passages. |
### Scenario entry points
| Scenario | Recommended R&S focus | Key test capabilities | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall development / compliance preparation | CMX500 + CMX-KA098 | Realistic network conditions, PSAP simulation, voice/data NG eCall, EN 17240:2024 validation [12] | [12] |
| Connected vehicle modem validation | CMX500 | 5G NR/LTE network emulation, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, signaling and measurements [9] | [9] |
| Infotainment WLAN / Wi‑Fi 7 validation | CMX500 | WLAN signaling, Wi‑Fi 7 signaling-mode TX/RX, MLO, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence, E2E testing [9][16] | [9][16] |
| OTA connectivity validation | CMX500 in OTA systems | Cellular and WLAN testing with one CMX500 signaling tester for essential current transmission standards [28] | [28] |
| Radar sensor validation | AREG800A | Dynamic artificial object generation and automotive radar echo generation up to 3000 m [13] | [13] |
### Inference lines
【Inference】For automotive signaling, the strongest first-line capability is CMX500-based cellular/eCall/WLAN signaling because R&S automotive applications include connectivity and infotainment, and CMX500 is the cited platform for 5G/LTE/WLAN signaling plus NG eCall testing [9][12][16][26].
【Inference】AREG800A should be positioned as an adjacent automotive radar test solution, not as a signaling-test substitute, because the cited passages describe it as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation rather than a communications signaling tester [13].
【Inference】High-speed in-vehicle-network signal-integrity topics may be relevant only as a secondary discussion: R&S automotive scope includes in-vehicle networks, and R&S digital-test material lists SerDes/SI/PI, GMSL, ASA, IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance, but the passages do not tie a specific automotive signaling option to those interfaces [10][26].

- 文件頁尾標示：© 2025 Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG，81671 Munich, Germany。
- 文件頁尾也描述 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] electronics group 的 business fields 包含 test and measurement、broadcast and media、secure communications、cybersecurity、monitoring and network testing。
- 來源稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 成立超過 80 年，總部位於 Munich, Germany，並在超過 70 個國家設有 sales and service network。
- 來源列出 website、training、customer support 與 ISO 9001 certified quality management 線索。

- markdown 頁尾標示 `COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL`。

- markdown 頁尾標示 `COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL`。
- 頁尾列出 `Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG ©`。

- 來源本身只支撐頁尾 copyright / confidential 標示，不支撐公司法律資訊或產品承諾。

依 [[Logical Channels]]：

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：

- [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 的 AUX IF output、RX power output、AUX IF input 與 connector 資訊。
- [[R&S QAT100]] 搭配 [[R&S AREG800A]] 的 IF level 與 amplitude flatness 摘要。
- 讀圖補充 p001、p021、p022、p023 的低可信度註記。
- `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` 條件、RF transfer characteristics 中未完整保留 option code 的 unresolved 記錄。

本來源與其他 Rohde & Schwarz Productions 頁面（如 [[R&S SGU100A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]）同屬 test & measurement 產品資料，但用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

欣銓 › 來源中的說法
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC]] 在功率半導體封測區塊將 [[欣銓]] 寫為「車用與功率IC測試核心廠」。

朋程 › 來源中的說法
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）將 [[朋程]] 列於產業分類「整流/車用二極體」。
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC image 1]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在核心能力欄寫「車用整流二極體全球第一」。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown，封面標題為 **What is Serdes and SI/PI?**，作者 / 講者標示為 [[Dr. Milton Lien]]，單位為 Product & Application Engineering, [[RSTW]]，日期標示 **2026.3.4**。
- 簡報把 R&S Group division 1 targets 分成 **Digital**、**Power**、**RF** 三類，並將 [[SerDes]]、[[Signal Integrity]]、[[Power Integrity]] 與 [[PCB]] / [[PCBA]] 測試放在 Digital / high-speed digital 測試脈絡中。
- Slide 4 列出多個 high speed SerDes standards / interfaces：[[GMSL]]、[[OIF CEI-112G]]、[[LVDS]]、[[JESD204D]]、[[DisplayPort]]、[[HDMI]]、[[MIPI]]、[[USB]]、[[ASA]]、[[UALink]]、[[PCIe]]、[[NVLink]]、[[Ultra Ethernet]]、[[InfiniBand]]、[[SATA]]、[[SAS]]；來源只列名，未提供各標準版本、發布組織、資料率或測試條件。
- Slide 5 以 **Parallel v.s. Serial Interface** 作為主題，但轉檔文字主要只有標題與圖片嵌入，未擷取圖中細節；因此只能作為 [[Parallel Interface]] / [[Serial Interface]] 需回看原始簡報的線索。
- Slide 9 以表格整理 [[High speed SerDes eco-chain]]，分成上游基礎材料與核心元件、中游模組整合與生產製造、下游終端應用與市場部署三層。
- Slide 11 題為 **Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces**，把高速電性介面驗證拆成 transmission channel、measurement path to DUT / test board development、[[Power Distribution Network]]、ADC / DAC frontend performance、RefClk and PLL jitter performance、interface test 等區塊，並列出 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices、phase noise analyzers、signal generators、network analyzers、spectrum analyzers 等儀器類型。
- Slide 17 題為 **HDI vs Package substrate**，以 [[CoWoS]]、[[Package Substrate]]、[[ABF]]、L/S 與 pitch 等字樣比較，但轉檔文字排列不完整，數值對應關係未能可靠確認。
- Slide 20 題為 **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA**，列出 [[IL]] / [[Xtalk]] / [[Eye diagram]]、[[TDR Impedance]]、[[Stackup Planner]]、[[TL Calculator]]。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

主要能力與限制：

- 來源未標示日期，因此不能把上述列名寫成特定時間點的市場現況。
- 來源是概念股整理表，不構成投資建議或供應鏈驗證。

- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

answer.text:
Recommendation: prioritize R&S CMX500 signaling capabilities for automotive connectivity, infotainment, and emergency-call testing; keep radar echo generation and PCB/SerDes signal-integrity work as important adjacent automotive test areas, but not primary “signaling tester” capabilities [9][12][16][26].
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Automotive need it can address | Knowledge-base-confirmed option / spec | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Automotive connectivity, eCall, infotainment, and wireless device validation | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD; NR/LTE signaling; WLAN signaling; fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI, throughput, PER; IMS/audio/POLQA [9] | It is the main R&S signaling platform in the passages and directly covers cellular, WLAN, application, IMS/audio, and performance testing [9]. | [9] | Pricing and full automotive test-package configuration are not stated. |
| R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | NG eCall testing | R&S CMX-KA098 software option for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [12] | It was used to verify NG eCall for Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF, simulating a PSAP and validating EN 17240:2024 voice/data compliance [12]. | [12] | The passages do not provide a complete certification test-plan list. |
| R&S CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 signaling | Automotive infotainment/connectivity WLAN validation | Integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality; signaling-mode RF TX/RX; MLO; 2x2 MIMO; 6 GHz out-of-band discovery; coexistence; E2E [16] | Wi‑Fi 7 signaling in real-world conditions supports connected infotainment and coexistence-style validation [16][26]. | [16][26] | Automotive-specific Wi‑Fi 7 test cases are not enumerated. |
| R&S CMP180 | Production RF testing complement, not primary signaling | Production non-signaling RF testing for Wi‑Fi 7 [8] | It complements CMX500 when moving from R&D signaling to production non-signaling RF testing [8]. | [8] | Not a signaling capability in the cited passages. |
### Scenario entry points
| Scenario | Recommended R&S focus | Key test capabilities | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall development / compliance preparation | CMX500 + CMX-KA098 | Realistic network conditions, PSAP simulation, voice/data NG eCall, EN 17240:2024 validation [12] | [12] |
| Connected vehicle modem validation | CMX500 | 5G NR/LTE network emulation, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, signaling and measurements [9] | [9] |
| Infotainment WLAN / Wi‑Fi 7 validation | CMX500 | WLAN signaling, Wi‑Fi 7 signaling-mode TX/RX, MLO, 2x2 MIMO, coexistence, E2E testing [9][16] | [9][16] |
| OTA connectivity validation | CMX500 in OTA systems | Cellular and WLAN testing with one CMX500 signaling tester for essential current transmission standards [28] | [28] |
| Radar sensor validation | AREG800A | Dynamic artificial object generation and automotive radar echo generation up to 3000 m [13] | [13] |
### Inference lines
【Inference】For automotive signaling, the strongest first-line capability is CMX500-based cellular/eCall/WLAN signaling because R&S automotive applications include connectivity and infotainment, and CMX500 is the cited platform for 5G/LTE/WLAN signaling plus NG eCall testing [9][12][16][26].
【Inference】AREG800A should be positioned as an adjacent automotive radar test solution, not as a signaling-test substitute, because the cited passages describe it as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation rather than a communications signaling tester [13].
【Inference】High-speed in-vehicle-network signal-integrity topics may be relevant only as a secondary discussion: R&S automotive scope includes in-vehicle networks, and R&S digital-test material lists SerDes/SI/PI, GMSL, ASA, IL, Xtalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance, but the passages do not tie a specific automotive signaling option to those interfaces [10][26].

cited_passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes.pptx` 轉出的 lossy markdown，封面標題為 **What is Serdes and SI/PI?**，作者 / 講者標示為 [[Dr. Milton Lien]]，單位為 Product & Application Engineering, [[RSTW]]，日期標示 **2026.3.4**。
- 簡報把 R&S Group division 1 targets 分成 **Digital**、**Power**、**RF** 三類，並將 [[SerDes]]、[[Signal Integrity]]、[[Power Integrity]] 與 [[PCB]] / [[PCBA]] 測試放在 Digital / high-speed digital 測試脈絡中。
- Slide 4 列出多個 high speed SerDes standards / interfaces：[[GMSL]]、[[OIF CEI-112G]]、[[LVDS]]、[[JESD204D]]、[[DisplayPort]]、[[HDMI]]、[[MIPI]]、[[USB]]、[[ASA]]、[[UALink]]、[[PCIe]]、[[NVLink]]、[[Ultra Ethernet]]、[[InfiniBand]]、[[SATA]]、[[SAS]]；來源只列名，未提供各標準版本、發布組織、資料率或測試條件。
- Slide 5 以 **Parallel v.s. Serial Interface** 作為主題，但轉檔文字主要只有標題與圖片嵌入，未擷取圖中細節；因此只能作為 [[Parallel Interface]] / [[Serial Interface]] 需回看原始簡報的線索。
- Slide 9 以表格整理 [[High speed SerDes eco-chain]]，分成上游基礎材料與核心元件、中游模組整合與生產製造、下游終端應用與市場部署三層。
- Slide 11 題為 **Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces**，把高速電性介面驗證拆成 transmission channel、measurement path to DUT / test board development、[[Power Distribution Network]]、ADC / DAC frontend performance、RefClk and PLL jitter performance、interface test 等區塊，並列出 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices、phase noise analyzers、signal generators、network analyzers、spectrum analyzers 等儀器類型。
- Slide 17 題為 **HDI vs Package substrate**，以 [[CoWoS]]、[[Package Substrate]]、[[ABF]]、L/S 與 pitch 等字樣比較，但轉檔文字排列不完整，數值對應關係未能可靠確認。
- Slide 20 題為 **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA**，列出 [[IL]] / [[Xtalk]] / [[Eye diagram]]、[[TDR Impedance]]、[[Stackup Planner]]、[[TL Calculator]]。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

主要能力與限制：

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

As a global provider of innovative test and measurement instruments, software and systems, Rohde & Schwarz employs its technical expertise to advance the automotive industry’s vision of autonomous driving, electrification, and connectivity. OEMs, chip suppliers, tier1s and engineering service providers, as well as certification organizations around the world rely on the test solutions for radar, connectivity including antennas, infotainment, in-vehicle networks, electric drivetrain components and electromagnetic compatibility. Rohde & Schwarz supports its customers over the entire automotive lifecycle from R&D to production and beyond.[![](https://assets.rohde-schwarz.com/public/image/market-segment/automotive/connectivity/emergency-call-connectivity_200_58356_320_180_1.jpg)](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/solutions/automotive-testing/automotive-connectivity-and-infotainment/automotive-ecall-testing/overview_231772.html)
